relationships.subject: MAPK signaling pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: This activation prompts the expression of matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) such as MMP-1, MMP-13, and cyclooxygenase-238–40.

key_findings: JUN, MYC and VEGFA mRNA and protein were significantly elevated in OA synovial tissue and correlated positively with K-L score, pain duration and synovial score.
p38-MAPK and phosphorylated p38-MAPK were elevated in OA synovium, suggesting a link to increased Myc, Jun and VEGFA.
